notes: harbin.org is behind Cloudflare and returns 'Attention Required' to a bare/short User-Agent; a full Chrome UA string works. Property was largely destroyed in the September 2015 Valley Fire and partially reopened January 2019 (pools, sauna, limited cafe). Rebuild is ongoing: the site's August 2026 photo gallery documents a brand-new restaurant (ribbon-cutting/blessing ceremony, Aug 2026) and a new multi-story hotel with elevator under construction/finishing. Lodging currently on the accommodations page: domes (rooms 30-53), hotel rooms, caravans, and tent camping. Some gallery images carry a small 'harbin.org' watermark in the corner. Operated by Heart Consciousness Church (nonprofit); pools are clothing-optional.
